product_metadata.title: 40 PCS Clear Heads Twist Pins with Storage Box, 2 Styles Bedskirt Pins for Upholstery, Slipcovers, and Bedskirts Decoration
features: Basic Information: 40 PCS, 2 Styles, 20 PCS each. The length is 0.59inch/1.5cm, can be firmly held, simple and convenient, made of high-quality materials, beautiful and rust-proof, can be firmly fixed on the furniture without damaging the fabric.

Has Many Uses: These twist nails are used to make tight-fitting caps. They are suitable for upholstery, armrest covers, covers, bed skirts, bedspreads, easy to disassemble and easy to use, to fix the skirt on the mattress.
Safety and No Damage: No damage to the fabric or bedding, it can be used safely on any type of fabric and spring box. When you need to remove these bed skirt pins, you can easily unscrew them.
Box packaging: Our twist pins come with a packaging box. All twist pins are stored in a box, which is convenient to carry and store without taking up space.
Note: Sharp parts, please pay attention to safety; keep away from children.
